text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original cinematic environment background for Vicky's interactive story scene library, preview awaiting approval. Produce ONE landscape image, 1536x1024, no collage, no border or captions. The fantasy must feel like a beautifully photographed tangible film set with convincing architecture and natural material detail, not an illustration or plastic game render. Vicky taste: bright high-key exposure with retained surface detail, soft broad frontal/fill illumination, low shadows and gentle contrast, cream white / pale gray / warm brown foundation, theme-specific restrained pastel colors, slight film halation. Eye-level natural 50mm perspective from suitable distance, layered spatial depth but keep environment readable and compositing-friendly, no extreme wide angle. Entire scene is unoccupied: absolutely no people, characters, silhouettes, human reflections, humanoid robots, portraits, statues, mannequins, animals, birds, fish or insects. Plants are allowed. No text, logos or watermarks. Original arrangement inspired by researched world-building only; do not reproduce an existing movie frame.
Scene: An original xianxia spirit-lotus lake high in a mountain valley, a graceful low white-jade stone bridge leading to a small open gray-tile pavilion, pale blush lotus flowers and soft jade leaves, mountain silhouettes emerging from bright thin mist. Clear walkable foreground shore, delicate restrained magical glimmer on water only, no immortals, cranes, fish or dragons.
